gate_beam.text: That gate beam should have been up a week ago.
gate_beam.title: The Gate Beam

darin_permit.text: Darin talks too smoothly for an honest trader. You'd want to know he's square with the town before you seal anything of his again.
darin_permit.title: The Merchant's Permit

fog.text: The night patrols lose their way when the fog comes down, and the watch pays for it. You'd give a great deal for a way to hold a heading without stars.
fog.title: Lost in the Fog

forge_iron.text: Mara's slow with the guards' mail, but her work holds. You'd like it done before the next muster.
forge_iron.title: The Guards' Order

gate_beam.text: Tomas is taking too long over the beam. You want it up, and safely.
gate_beam.title: The Gate Beam

kade_knees.text: Kade's slowing on the long patrol. Twenty years; he's earned better than pasture, but the watch needs legs.
kade_knees.title: The Old Soldier

oren_debt.text: Oren's not been himself: jumpy, pale, hiding from somebody. You'd like someone to find out what's eating him.
oren_debt.title: Dice and Debts

oren_debt.text: Oren's young and scared of something, and it's wearing on you too. You'd like to know what's eating him before it gets you both in trouble.
oren_debt.title: Dice and Debts

oren_debt.text: You're carrying something you can't speak of, and every time Darin comes near the gate your stomach turns. You'd give anything for it to go away quietly.
oren_debt.title: Dice and Debts

trough_water.text: Two of her guests fell sick after drinking from the trough: she'd be grateful to anyone who found out why.
trough_water.title: The Wayside Inn

trough_water.text: Your inn is your life and your guests are falling sick. Bren's tired and short with you lately, and some old griefs never quite heal.
trough_water.title: The Wayside Inn

forge_iron.text: The guards' order won't wait and her forge is starved: she'd welcome good fuel, charcoal or dry wood.
forge_iron.title: The Guards' Order

forge_iron.text: The guards' order is late and Roderic wants miracles at a smith's wage. Your forge eats fuel faster than you can buy it, and good iron is scarce.
forge_iron.title: The Guards' Order

jory.text: Jory's been jumpy and keeping out of your way. He's a good lad, but he has to learn that a smith owns her mistakes.
jory.title: The Apprentice

jory.text: He'd love to see something nobody here has ever seen: a real wonder.
jory.title: The Apprentice

npc_darin_ko.text: has the most interesting things in the world

npc_mara_venn.text: his aunt; he'd do anything to impress her

npc_tomas_reed.text: clever with wood, and lets him watch

jory.text: Aunt Mara's been short with you lately and you've a weight on your mind. You'd give anything to see something nobody's ever seen.
jory.title: The Apprentice

gate_beam.text: Sixty kilos of beam to raise two metres into the brackets: he could use a clever pair of hands.
gate_beam.title: The Gate Beam

gate_beam.text: Sixty kilos of oak, two metres up, and the captain watching you like a hawk. You'll get this one right.
gate_beam.title: The Gate Beam

darin_permit.text: Goods nobody here wants, and a city he can't sell in yet: he'd like to be shown something new that would sell.
darin_permit.title: The Merchant's Permit

darin_permit.text: You need one good deal inside the walls, and soon. Something new to sell would change everything.
darin_permit.title: The Merchant's Permit

oren_debt.text: Oren owes you and has stopped meeting your eye. You're not cruel, but a debt is a debt, and you have troubles of your own before the month is out.
oren_debt.title: Dice and Debts

fog.text: The watch loses its way on the moor road in fog: she'd welcome any way to hold a heading without stars.
fog.title: Lost in the Fog

kade_knees.text: Kade's limping on patrol and won't admit it: she'd be glad if someone helped him without shaming him.
kade_knees.title: The Old Soldier

fog.text: The fog on the moor road has beaten the watch, and there's a night you'd rather forget. You want to be the scout who never loses her way again.
fog.title: Lost in the Fog

fog.text: You know the moor from the bad nights. The young ones think fog is weather; you know it kills.
fog.title: Lost in the Fog

kade_knees.text: Twenty years under Roderic, and the patrol gets longer every year. You'll not be pitied, and you'll not be put out to pasture.
kade_knees.title: The Old Soldier
